subject: general
question: Which of the following dams was constructed on river Ganga?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Tehri dam.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points:__**

__
 
• The **Tehri** Dam is the highest dam in India and the **fourth**-**highest** dam in the entire planet.
 
• It measures about **260.5** metres in **height** and **592** metres in **length**.
 
• It is a part of the Tehri Dam & **Hydro** **Power** **Project**, a multi-use river valley project created to take advantage of the vast potential for **irrigation** and **hydropower** offered by the River **Ganga**.
 
• It is located in **Tehri** district of **Uttarakhand**.

 The Tehri dam's reservoir is filled with **rock** and **earth**.
 
• Its **spillway** **system** consists of three radial spillway gates on a **chute** **spillway** and four **shaft** **spillways**. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information:__**

 
• **Chamera dam:**

 
 
• The **Chamera** **Dam**** **blocks the River **Ravi**, aiding the neighborhood's **hydroelectricity** **project**.
 
• It is located close to the town of **Dalhousie** in the **Chamba** region in the Indian state of **Himachal** **Pradesh**.
 
• The reservoir for the dam is **Chamera** **Lake**.
 
• Its reservoir is situated in the **Salooni** **subdivision** of Chamba.**​**
 
 
 
• **Koyna dam:**
 
 
• The **Koyna** **Dam** is one of Maharashtra, India's largest dams.
 
• It is a concrete and debris dam that was constructed on the Koyna River, which originates in the hill town of **Mahabaleshwar** in the **Sahyadri** **highlands**.
 
• It is located in Koyna Nagar, Satara district, in the **Western** **Ghats**, on the public highway that runs between **Chiplun**** **and **Karad**.**​**
 
 
 
• **Rihand dam:**
 
 
• The **Rihand** **Dam**, also known as **Govind** **Ballabh** **Pant** **Sagar**, is the **largest** **dam** in India in terms of **volume**.
 
• The reservoir of the Rihand Dam, Govind Ballabh Pant Sagar, contains India's **largest man-made lake.**
 
• The Rihand Dam is a concrete gravity dam located at **Pipri** in the **Sonbhadra** **District** of **Uttar** **Pradesh**, India.
 
 

2d
